lessons.title: Reformulate TriMul as batched GEMM
lessons.summary: Treat each hidden‑dim slice as an independent (N×N) matrix multiply and compute all B·H of them in one Triton kernel.
lessons.lesson: For the TriMul contraction out[b,i,j,d] = Σ_k left[b,i,k,d] * right[b,j,k,d], reshape left and right to (B, H, N, N) and launch a Triton kernel that performs a tiled GEMM A @ Bᵀ for each (batch, head) pair, accumulating in fp32 and writing fp32 results.

lessons.title: Permute to (B, H, N, N) before kernel
lessons.summary: Arrange tensors so the batch and hidden dimensions are outermost for efficient kernel indexing.
lessons.lesson: Before calling the Triton kernel, permute left and right from (B, N, N, H) to (B, H, N, N) and call .contiguous(); after the kernel, permute the output back to (B, N, N, H).

lessons.title: Pass correct strides to Triton kernel
lessons.summary: Provide explicit stride arguments matching the (B, H, N, N) layout to avoid compilation or correctness bugs.
lessons.lesson: When launching the kernel, compute and pass the four strides of each input and output tensor (batch, head, row, col) and use them inside the kernel for tl.load/store; never rely on flat pointers alone.

lessons.title: FP16 loads, FP32 accumulation
lessons.summary: Load matrix elements as half‑precision and accumulate in single‑precision for speed and accuracy.
lessons.lesson: In Triton matmul kernels, cast input loads to tl.float16 (or tl.bfloat16) and convert them to tl.float32 before dot‑product accumulation; store the final result as fp32. This maximizes bandwidth while preserving numerical quality.

lessons.title: Single launch for all batch‑head GEMMs
lessons.summary: Map each (batch, head) pair to the third grid dimension so one kernel computes all matrix multiplies.
lessons.lesson: Set the Triton grid to (ceil(N/TILE_M), ceil(N/TILE_N), batch * hidden_dim) and launch the kernel once; inside the kernel compute the global batch‑head index from blockIdx.z to select the appropriate A and B slices. This eliminates per‑head launch overhead.
